houses.editor.add.context: Button that adds the spot typed.

houses.editor.addSide.context: Button that adds a side (another picture of the house).

houses.editor.conflictText.en: This house was saved in another window while you worked on it.
houses.editor.conflictText.context: Text of the note that the house was saved in another window meanwhile.

houses.editor.conflictTitle.context: Title of the note that the house was saved in another window meanwhile.

houses.editor.createFailed.context: Shown when making a new house failed (for another reason than the plan’s limit).

houses.editor.cropHint.en: Drag the corners round the house and its plot. Values sit beside this box, so leave out empty sky and lawn.

houses.editor.dark.context: Switch for a side whose picture is dark (an evening render): dark themes don’t dim it.

houses.editor.defaultName.context: The name a new house starts with.

houses.editor.deleteSide.context: Menu item that deletes the side.

houses.editor.deleteText.en: Its pictures stay in your pictures. Tiles that show it say it is gone until you pick another house.
houses.editor.deleteText.context: Text of the question before deleting a house.

houses.editor.deleteTitle.context: Title of the question before deleting a house.

houses.editor.description.en: Pictures of your home with its places marked, for the Energy house tile.
houses.editor.description.context: Line under the title of the houses page.

houses.editor.empty.en: No houses yet. Make one to put your own home on the Energy house.
houses.editor.empty.context: Shown on the houses page while the person has none.

houses.editor.full.en: Your plan holds {max, plural, one {# house} other {# houses}}.
houses.editor.full.context: Shown instead of making a new house when the person has as many as their plan holds.

params.max: How many houses the plan holds.

houses.editor.getPicture.en: Get a picture for this side
houses.editor.getPicture.context: Heading over the ways to get this side’s picture.

houses.editor.homey.context: Label of the choice of which Homey the house belongs to.

houses.editor.houseName.context: Label of the house’s name field in the editor.

houses.editor.keepMine.context: Saves the house as it is here over the other changes.

houses.editor.limit.context: How many houses the person has of how many their plan holds, beside the page’s title.

houses.editor.loadFailed.context: Shown when the houses page or the editor couldn’t read the houses.

houses.editor.missing.en: This house isn’t there any more.
houses.editor.missing.context: Shown in the editor when the house it opens was deleted, or isn’t one of the person’s.

houses.editor.modes.context: The editor’s three views of a side: cropping the picture to the house, placing its spots, and a preview of the tile.

houses.editor.modesLabel.context: Accessible name of the choice between Crop, Spots and Preview.

houses.editor.moveEarlier.context: Menu item that moves the side one place earlier.

houses.editor.moveLater.context: Menu item that moves the side one place later.

houses.editor.newHouse.context: Button that makes a new house and opens it in the editor.

houses.editor.newSide.en: {side, select, front {Front} back {Back} left {Left side} right {Right side} other {Other…}}
houses.editor.newSide.context: Menu under “Add a side”: which side of the house to add. The first four become its name; Other adds one to name yourself (a basement, a pool side).

params.side: front, back, left, right or other.

houses.editor.noHomey.context: Choice for a house tied to none of the person’s Homeys (its tiles can be on any).

houses.editor.open.context: Button that opens a house in the editor.

houses.editor.ownCount.context: How many own spots the house has of how many it may.

houses.editor.ownPlaceholder.context: Placeholder of the field that adds a spot of the person’s own.

houses.editor.paused.context: Under a house that is paused: the account has more houses than its plan holds, so it shows nowhere and can’t be changed.

houses.editor.pausedText.en: Your plan holds fewer houses. It shows nowhere and can’t be changed.
houses.editor.pausedText.context: Text of the note in the editor that the house is paused.

houses.editor.pausedTitle.context: Title of the note in the editor for a paused house.

houses.editor.previewHint.en: Your house with demo values, as a wide tile shows it. A value shows on the sides where its spot is placed.

houses.editor.previewTheme.context: The looks the preview can show: a dark theme, a light one, or an e-ink screen.

houses.editor.removeOwn.context: Button that deletes one of the person’s own spots from the house.

houses.editor.rename.context: Menu item that renames the side.

houses.editor.replace.context: Button that gives the side another picture.

houses.editor.reset.context: Button that makes the crop the whole picture again.

houses.editor.sideMenu.context: Accessible name of the button that opens a side’s menu.

houses.editor.sideName.context: The name a new side starts with: the first is the front, then the back, then the garden side.

houses.editor.sides.context: How many sides (each its own picture: front, back, garden side) a house has.

houses.editor.sidesLabel.context: Label of the row of the house’s sides in the editor.

houses.editor.spotName.en: {spot, select, solar {Solar panels} grid {Grid connection} home {The house} battery {Home battery} car {Car} charger {Charger} meter {Meter cupboard} upstairs {Upstairs} heat-pump {Heat pump} garage {Garage} other {Garden}}
houses.editor.spotName.context: The places of a house values can point at.

houses.editor.spotState.context: Whether a spot is placed on this side, on others (named), or nowhere.

houses.editor.spotsHint.en: Tap a spot, then the picture. Drag a pin to move it.
houses.editor.spotsHint.context: Help over the list of spots.

houses.editor.spotsTitle.context: Heading of the list of places values can point at.

houses.editor.status.en: {status, select, saved {Saved} saving {Saving…} offline {Offline: saves when back} other {Not saved yet}}
houses.editor.status.context: What the editor’s top bar says about saving the house.

houses.editor.takeOff.context: Button that takes a spot off this side.

houses.editor.takeTheirs.context: Drops the changes here and shows the house as saved elsewhere.

houses.editor.tapWhere.context: Shown over the picture after picking a spot from the list.

houses.editor.title.context: Title of the page that lists the person’s own houses, and the editor’s way back to it.

houses.editor.tryAgain.context: Button that reads the houses again.

houses.editor.upload.context: Way to get the side’s picture: one the person made themselves.

houses.editor.uploadAnother.context: Button in the dialog of a failed upload: picks another file to upload.

houses.editor.uploadClose.context: Button that closes the dialog of a failed upload.

houses.editor.uploadFailed.context: Title of the dialog when uploading a side’s picture failed; the dialog says why under it.

houses.editor.uploadHint.en: One you made yourself. You place its spots.

houses.editor.uploadProblem.en: {problem, select, type {Tiledash takes PNG, JPEG and WebP pictures, and this browser couldn’t turn this file into one. Save it as a PNG or JPEG and try again.} unreadable {This file couldn’t be opened as a picture. It may be damaged, or in a format this browser can’t read, such as HEIC. Save it as a PNG or JPEG and try again.} too-big {A picture can be at most {limit} MB, and this one is bigger even made smaller. Try a smaller picture.} too-large {A picture can have at most {limit} million pixels. Try a smaller picture.} limit {Your account keeps {limit} pictures at most, and it has that many. Delete one you no longer use, then try again.} space {Your pictures take all the room your account has ({limit} MB together). Delete one you no longer use, then try again.} offline {Tiledash couldn’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.} other {Something went wrong on our side while keeping it. Try again in a moment.}}
houses.editor.uploadProblem.context: Why uploading a side’s picture failed and what to do, in the dialog "The picture couldn’t be uploaded". PNG, JPEG, WebP and HEIC are file types and are not translated.

params.limit: The limit that was hit: megabytes, millions of pixels, or a number of pictures.
params.problem: type, unreadable, too-big, too-large, limit, space, offline or failed.

houses.editor.uploadSent.context: Beside "Uploading it": how much of the picture has been sent.

houses.editor.uploadSize.context: Beside "Getting it ready": the picture’s size, sent as it is.

houses.editor.uploadSmaller.context: Beside "Getting it ready": the picture was big, so it was made smaller to send.

houses.editor.uploadStep.en: {step, select, prepare {Getting it ready} send {Uploading it} other {Keeping it with your house}}
houses.editor.uploadStep.context: A step of uploading a side’s picture, in a list with a tick or spinner each: made ready in the browser (made smaller when it is big), sent, then kept by Tiledash.

houses.editor.uploadTitle.context: Title of the dialog that shows the steps of uploading a side’s picture.

houses.editor.uploading.context: Shown while the side’s picture is being uploaded.

houses.generation.acceptAll.context: Button that accepts all the placed spots as they are.

houses.generation.another.context: Button that opens the questions again to refine the side’s picture (say what should change) or make a new one, for a credit.

houses.generation.ask.context: Beside the thumbs up and down on a generated picture.

houses.generation.beforeRefining.context: Name of the side’s picture a refinement started from (one the owner uploaded), listed with the tries to go back to.

houses.generation.credits.context: How many credits the person has, in the editor’s top bar.

houses.generation.deleteTry.context: Button that deletes a try’s picture (not the one in use).

houses.generation.dialogTitle.context: Title of the dialog that asks a few questions and then generates the side’s picture.

houses.generation.error.en: {error, select, busy {A picture is being made already.} limit {That’s enough pictures for today; try again tomorrow.} off {Making pictures isn’t available here.} photo {That photo couldn’t be read. Try another (PNG, JPEG or WebP).} other {The picture couldn’t be started.}}
houses.generation.error.context: Why generating a picture couldn’t start.

params.error: busy, limit, off, photo or failed.

houses.generation.failed.context: Under a try that failed (its credit came back).

houses.generation.failedText.en: {status, select, refused {The image model wouldn’t make it from this photo or prompt. Your credit is back.} other {Something went wrong making it. Your credit is back.}}
houses.generation.failedText.context: Text of that note: refused by the model’s safety rules, or another failure.

houses.generation.failedTitle.context: Title of the note that a generation failed.

houses.generation.givenBack.context: Under a try whose credit an admin gave back, with the admin’s reason.

params.reason: The admin’s reason, as they wrote it.

houses.generation.glad.context: Beside the thumbs after a thumbs up.

houses.generation.good.context: Accessible name of the thumbs up.

houses.generation.inUse.context: Under the try that is the side’s picture now.

houses.generation.making.context: Shown on the side while its picture is being generated.

houses.generation.makingHint.en: About half a minute. You can leave this page: it carries on.

houses.generation.notGood.context: Accessible name of the thumbs down.

houses.generation.note.context: Placeholder of the free text after a thumbs down.

houses.generation.pending.context: Under a try that is still being made.

houses.generation.proposedText.en: Check each one: drag it where it belongs, or drop it.
houses.generation.proposedText.context: Text of the note "We placed your spots", after a generation.

houses.generation.proposedTitle.context: Title of the note after a generation: spots were placed on the picture for the person.

houses.generation.reason.en: {reason, select, not-my-house {Doesn’t look like my house} parts {Parts missing or wrong} strange {Strange bits} style {Not the style I chose} other {Cut off or badly framed}}
houses.generation.reason.context: What went wrong with a generated picture, each a chip to pick.

houses.generation.refine.context: Button beside “Replace picture” over a side’s picture: opens the questions to say what should change in it (the image model then changes only that, for a credit).

houses.generation.refined.context: Name of a try that refined the side’s picture (instead of its style); what was asked shows on hover.

houses.generation.send.context: Sends the thumbs down with its reasons.

houses.generation.thanks.en: Thanks. We look at every thumbs down; when the picture is our mess, you get the credit back.
houses.generation.thanks.context: Shown after sending a thumbs down.

houses.generation.triesHint.en: Every try stays here. Using another keeps the spots you placed; check they still fit.

houses.generation.triesTitle.context: Heading over the side’s generated pictures, every one kept.

houses.generation.useTry.context: Accessible name of a try: makes it the side’s picture.

houses.generation.way.context: Way to get a side’s picture: generated in Tiledash for a credit (the main way).

houses.generation.wayCost.context: Badge on "Make it in Tiledash": what it costs and how many credits the person has.

params.count: How many credits the person has.

houses.generation.wayHint.en: From a photo of your house, or a few answers about it, in the style you choose. Its spots come placed for you.

houses.generation.whatWrong.context: Heading over the reasons after a thumbs down.

houses.generation.writePrompt.en: Write a prompt for your own ChatGPT or Gemini
houses.generation.writePrompt.context: Link inside "Upload a picture" that opens the prompt generator.

houses.spots.addInstead.context: Button on a reading taken off a value: makes it added again.

houses.spots.addReading.context: Button that adds a reading to a value, added up with the others.

houses.spots.addValue.context: Button adding a value to a spot.

houses.spots.decimals.context: Label of how many decimals a value shows.

houses.spots.decimalsAuto.context: Choice of decimals: as many as read well.

houses.spots.hint.en: Open a spot to see what it shows and place it on the picture. Every tile showing this house shows the same.
houses.spots.hint.context: Help over the list of spots in the house editor.

houses.spots.homeHint.en: Worked out from your grid, solar, battery and car, so it needs no reading of its own.

houses.spots.homeTitle.context: In the open spot "The house": the power the house uses.

houses.spots.label.context: Label of a value’s label field.

houses.spots.labelPlaceholder.context: Placeholder of a value’s label field.

houses.spots.moveDown.context: Button moving a value one down.

houses.spots.moveUp.context: Button moving a value one up.

houses.spots.newValue.context: A value without a label yet.

houses.spots.noHomeyText.en: Its spots show readings of that Homey’s devices. Pick it in the bar above to give them values.

houses.spots.noHomeyTitle.context: Shown over the spots of a house that belongs to no Homey yet.

houses.spots.notPlaced.en: {elsewhere, select, yes {Shows on another side. Place it here too?} other {Not on a side yet: what it shows appears once it’s placed.}}
houses.spots.notPlaced.context: In an open spot that isn’t placed on the side shown.

params.elsewhere: yes when it is placed on another side, else no.

houses.spots.otherHomeyText.en: Switch to that Homey to change what its spots show.
houses.spots.otherHomeyText.context: Under "This house belongs to another Homey".

houses.spots.otherHomeyTitle.en: This house belongs to another Homey
houses.spots.otherHomeyTitle.context: Shown over the spots of a house whose Homey isn’t the one open in the app now.

houses.spots.partState.en: {state, select, off {Not shown} meters {From your meters} other {Chosen readings}}
houses.spots.partState.context: Under an energy spot’s name (solar, grid, battery, car): left off the house, following the account’s energy meters, or readings chosen for this house.

houses.spots.placeIt.context: Button in an open spot: then a tap on the picture places it.

houses.spots.placedHere.en: On this side: drag its pin to move it.
houses.spots.placedHere.context: In an open spot that is placed on the side shown.

houses.spots.preset.en: {preset, select, terraced {Terraced house} semi-detached {Semi-detached house} bungalow {Bungalow} flat {Flat with a balcony} other {Detached house}}
houses.spots.preset.context: Names of Tiledash’s ready-made pictures of a house: one in the middle of a row, one half of a pair sharing a wall, a single-storey one, a flat with a balcony in a small block, and one standing alone with a garage.

params.preset: terraced, semi-detached, bungalow, flat or detached.

houses.spots.presetWay.context: A way to get a picture for a side: one of Tiledash’s ready pictures of a house.

houses.spots.presetWayHint.en: Start from one of ours; you can make your own later.

houses.spots.readings.context: Over the readings a value is made of; several are added up (or taken off).

houses.spots.removeReading.context: Button that takes a reading out of a value.

houses.spots.summary.en: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing yet} one {# value} other {# values}}
houses.spots.summary.context: Under a spot’s name: how many values it shows.

houses.spots.takeOffInstead.context: Button on a reading added to a value: makes it taken off (washer off the meter).

houses.spots.todayTitle.context: The row of today’s energy totals, shown under the house.

houses.spots.todayWhere.context: Where today’s totals show, under their row’s name.

houses.spots.valueCount.context: How many values a spot shows of how many it may.

houses.spots.valuesHere.context: Heading over a spot’s own values; "Also here" on an energy spot, whose part is shown above them.

params.part: yes for an energy spot, else no.
